title: Apache Tomcat: Cluster TLS-PSK configured to use TLS 1.3 does not validate peer (CVE-2026-133325)
description: Apache Tomcat versions 9.0.124 through 9.0.124, 10.1.62 through 10.1.62, and 11.0.28 through 11.0.29 contain a vulnerability in the cluster TLS-PSK configuration when using TLS 1.3. This flaw allows an unauthenticated node to join a cluster due to lack of peer validation during key exchange. The issue is fixed in versions 9.0.125, 10.1.63, and 11.0.30. Users are advised to upgrade to these fixed versions or switch to TLS 1.2 with TLS-PSK as a workaround.
